text: For fattening pigs, welfare and proper housing are closely tied to growth performance: split pigs into homogeneous groups (same age, same weight); allow about 1.5 m² per head; keep walls at least 1.2 m high to prevent escape; provide a bath for cooling, changing the water daily to stop microbes multiplying in organic-matter-rich water; and provide nipple drinkers at two heights (about 30 cm and 60 cm, one nipple per pig at each height) for pigs housed from 25 kg to 90 kg. For the boar's pen: keep the floor in good condition, since weakness or pain in the rear legs (from lameness) impairs mating ability; keep the pen cool, since heat reduces sperm quality; and allow enough room to move freely, with a pen size of 6 to 9 m².
